name: alexjsully-skills
description: Audit and coding-standards skills for documentation, pull requests, code quality, and TypeScript.

plugins.name: audit-docs
plugins.description: Audits and updates the project's documentation so it matches the current code, grounding every claim in a file opened this run.

plugins.name: audit-pr
plugins.description: Reviews a pull request or working-branch diff across triaged categories and returns one report whose findings quote the changed line and show the corrected code.

plugins.name: audit-quality
plugins.description: Audits code for architecture, security, privacy, testing, dependency, supply chain, and cost issues, returning one report whose findings carry file and symbol evidence and show each fix as code.

plugins.name: typescript-code-and-test-standards
plugins.description: Applies TypeScript and JavaScript standards that formatters and linters cannot catch, covering comment discipline, JSDoc, type-system defects, accessibility, the test mandate, and the mocking policy.
